identity.paletteIntent: Archive paper and ink with a single red grading pencil; the projected slides keep the project's arena black so students see what the board shows.
identity.typographyIntent: Newspaper serif for reading, the project's slab headline type, condensed labels and a handwritten red pencil face for grading marks.
identity.shapeLanguage: Slide mockups as dark rectangles on a paper desk, a rotated snapshot portrait and a rubber stamp.
interactionSignature: speaking time computed from the script
identity.densityRhythm: Short hero, then three slide and script pairs, each followed by a chart or video, then the clock and a do and do not list.
identity.archivalBehavior: Program scans are credited and kept small where soft. The primary source is quoted once, in his words, with its archive named.
identity.endingLanguage: Send students back to the heel list to pick their own wrestler.

assetToInterfaceTranslation.paletteSource: The yellowed program paper of the 1970s scans and the red ink of a grader.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.edgeTreatment: White snapshot borders and dashed red outlines that only appear when marks are on.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.controlLanguage: One stamp style toggle in the header and plain scorecard links.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.spacingLanguage: A reading column with a sticky scorecard beside it on wide screens.
assetToInterfaceTranslation.transitionLanguage: Natural scrolling; reduced motion sets the time bar instantly.
